business_summary: Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the manufacture and sale of chemical products in Japan, Taiwan, China, and internationally. It operates through metal surface treatment agents and equipment, electronic materials, automotive chemical products, and industrial chemicals segments. The company provides plating chemicals that are used in the production of electronic components for use in computers, office equipment, mobile phones, and digital appliances; tin and solder plating additives; and automatic control equipment for chemicals used in printed wiring board, plastic plating, flat-panel display, and plating process. It also offers welding chemicals; involved in the research and development of copper nano-particles and inks; electronic materials, such as submicron nickel powders for manufacturing of capacitor electrodes; ceramic materials, including machinable and engineering ceramics; and ceramic parts, which are used in various components and fixtures, such as semiconductor and LCD manufacturing equipment. In addition, the company develops, manufactures, and sells automotive chemicals under the Unicon brand, including car wash detergents for use at gas stations; maintenance chemicals for use at automotive inspection and repair shops, and FMC compounds and repair chemicals for use at body shops; car polish; finishing compounds; wash detergents; deodorant and sanitizer; and anti-spatter agents for welding, as well as consumer products for resale at automotive and other shops. Further, it distributes inorganic compounds and fine chemicals, including acids, alkalis, catalysts, and inorganic compounds. Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd. was founded in 1900 and is headquartered in Kobe, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Ishihara Chemical Co., Ltd.는 일본, 대만, 중국 및 해외에서 화학 제품의 제조 및 판매에 종사하고 있습니다. 금속표면처리제 및 장비, 전자재료, 자동차화학제품, 산업용화학제품 부문을 운영하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 컴퓨터, 사무기기, 휴대폰, 디지털 기기에 사용되는 전자 부품 생산에 사용되는 도금 화학 물질을 제공합니다. 주석 및 땜납 도금 첨가제; 인쇄배선판, 플라스틱 도금, 평판디스플레이, 도금공정에 사용되는 화학물질의 자동제어장치 등을 취급하고 있습니다. 또한 용접 화학물질도 제공합니다. 구리 나노 입자 및 잉크의 연구 및 개발에 참여합니다. 커패시터 전극 제조용 서브미크론 니켈 분말과 같은 전자 재료; 기계 가공 및 엔지니어링 세라믹을 포함한 세라믹 재료; 반도체, LCD 제조장비 등 각종 부품 및 고정 장치에 사용되는 세라믹 부품 등이 있습니다. 또한 회사는 주유소에서 사용하는 세차 세제를 포함하여 Unicon 브랜드로 자동차 화학 물질을 개발, 제조 및 판매합니다. 유지 보수 체
